## File: facebookresearch_fbpcs/fbpcs/infra/logging_service/download_logs/cloud/aws_cloud.py

Prompts

```
['fetch CloudWatch logs from a given log group and log stream in AWS', 'upload a local file to an S3 bucket folder with progress tracking and retries', 'create a new folder inside an S3 bucket if it does not already exist', 'list the contents of a folder in an S3 bucket with pagination support', 'retrieve Athena query execution details by its execution ID from AWS']
```

Usage

```
{'get_cloudwatch_logs': 'fetch CloudWatch logs from a given log group and log stream in AWS', 'upload_file_to_s3': 'upload a local file to an S3 bucket folder with progress tracking and retries', 'create_s3_folder': 'create a new folder inside an S3 bucket if it does not already exist', 'get_s3_folder_contents': 'list the contents of a folder in an S3 bucket with pagination support', 'get_athena_query_execution_details': 'retrieve Athena query execution details by its execution ID from AWS'}
```
